shared_elements: circle/disc motif carved in low relief
shallow incised or grooved linear bands
an ambiguous small anthropomorphic/abstract form set within or above a ring
justification: Both show a raised or outlined ring/disc cut in shallow relief on coarse grey stone, and in each the disc encloses or adjoins a small ambiguous form, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is a vertically stacked sequence of motifs on the curved back of a free-standing figure, whereas B is a strictly radial composition of long converging lines around a central roundel on a flat panel, and the carving in B is crisper and more geometrically regular.
